planets.name: K2-36 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-36 with a 1.42-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-36 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-36. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
